vulnerabilities.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in Vehicle Location API
vulnerabilities.description: Any authenticated user can query GPS location and real-time telemetry of any arbitrary vehicle by replacing vehicle_id UUID.

vulnerabilities.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in Workshop Orders API
vulnerabilities.description: Users can view full transaction and order details of any other customer by changing order_id.

vulnerabilities.title: Broken Function Level Authorization in Admin Coupon Creation
vulnerabilities.description: Standard user accounts can access administrative coupon creation endpoint without admin JWT claims.

vulnerabilities.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in User Vehicle Videos
vulnerabilities.description: Users can download dashboard camera footage uploaded by other vehicle owners.
